/**
 * Mindbox Activity Tracking - Полный клон jQuery plugin Activity с поддержкой Mindbox
 */
(function(global) {
    'use strict';

    var hasJQuery = typeof jQuery !== 'undefined';
    var $ = hasJQuery ? jQuery : null;

    function querySelector(selector) {
        if (hasJQuery) {
            return $(selector);
        }
        if (typeof selector === 'string') {
            return document.querySelector(selector);
        }
        return selector;
    }

    function bindEvent(element, events, handler) {
        if (hasJQuery && $(element).bind) {
            $(element).bind(events, handler);
        } else {
            var eventList = events.split(' ');
            eventList.forEach(function(eventName) {
                if (eventName) {
                    if (element.addEventListener) {
                        element.addEventListener(eventName, handler, false);
                    } else if (element.attachEvent) {
                        element.attachEvent('on' + eventName, handler);
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }

    function mindboxActivityTracking(options) {
        var timerHand = 0, data = {}, eventFlag = 0, trackingDepth = {
            depth: 0,
            visitedPages: [],
            startTime: Date.now()
        };

        data = {
            achieveTime: 90,
            targetDepth: 2,
            loop: 0,
            eventList: 'touchmove blur focus focusin focusout load resize scroll unload click dblclick mousedown mouseup mousemove mouseover mouseout mouseenter mouseleave change select submit keydown keypress keyup error',
            testPeriod: 10,
            useMultiMode: 1,
            callBack: function(e) { console.log('Achieved!'); },
            watchEvery: 1,
            sendToMindbox: true,
            mindboxOperation: "GlubinaProsmotraDostignuta",
            cookieKey: 'mindbox_activity',
            depthCookieKey: 'mindbox_depth',
            sentFlag: 'mindbox_activity_sent'
        };

        if (options) {
            for (var key in options) {
                if (options.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                    data[key] = options[key];
                }
            }
        }

        if (data.useMultiMode) {
            var cookie = ' ' + document.cookie;
            var searchFlag = ' ' + data.sentFlag + '=';
            if (cookie.indexOf(searchFlag) !== -1) {
                var offset = cookie.indexOf(searchFlag) + searchFlag.length;
                var flagValue = cookie.substring(offset, cookie.indexOf(";", offset) === -1 ? cookie.length : cookie.indexOf(";", offset));
                if (flagValue === 'true') {
                    return;
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined' && sessionStorage.getItem(data.sentFlag) === 'true') {
                return;
            }
        }

        if (data.useMultiMode) {
            var depthCookie = ' ' + document.cookie;
            var searchDepth = ' ' + data.depthCookieKey + '=';
            if (depthCookie.indexOf(searchDepth) !== -1) {
                var depthOffset = depthCookie.indexOf(searchDepth) + searchDepth.length;
                var depthValue = unescape(depthCookie.substring(depthOffset, depthCookie.indexOf(";", depthOffset) === -1 ? depthCookie.length : depthCookie.indexOf(";", depthOffset)));
                try {
                    var depthData = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(depthValue));
                    trackingDepth.depth = depthData.depth || 0;
                    trackingDepth.visitedPages = depthData.visitedPages || [];
                    if (depthData.startTime) {
                        trackingDepth.startTime = depthData.startTime;
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('Ошибка при загрузке данных глубины:', e);
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined') {
                var savedDepth = sessionStorage.getItem(data.depthCookieKey);
                if (savedDepth) {
                    try {
                        var parsed = JSON.parse(savedDepth);
                        trackingDepth.depth = parsed.depth || 0;
                        trackingDepth.visitedPages = parsed.visitedPages || [];
                        if (parsed.startTime) {
                            trackingDepth.startTime = parsed.startTime;
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.error('Ошибка при загрузке данных глубины:', e);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        var currentPage = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
        
        if (trackingDepth.visitedPages.indexOf(currentPage) === -1) {
            trackingDepth.visitedPages.push(currentPage);
            trackingDepth.depth = trackingDepth.visitedPages.length;
            
            var depthDataStr = JSON.stringify(trackingDepth);
            if (data.useMultiMode) {
                document.cookie = data.depthCookieKey + '=' + encodeURIComponent(depthDataStr) + '; path=/;';
            } else {
                if (typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined') {
                    sessionStorage.setItem(data.depthCookieKey, depthDataStr);
                }
            }
        }

        data.watchEvery *= 1000;
        data.counter = {'test': 0, 'achiev': 0};

        function loadMultiData() {
            var search = ' ' + data.cookieKey + '=';
            var cookie = ' ' + document.cookie;
            if (cookie.length > 0) {
                if (cookie.indexOf(search) !== -1) {
                    var offset = cookie.indexOf(search) + search.length;
                    var m = unescape(cookie.substring(offset, cookie.indexOf(";", offset) === -1 ? cookie.length : cookie.indexOf(";", offset))).split('|');
                    data.counter.test = parseInt(m[0]) || 0;
                    data.counter.achiev = parseInt(m[1]) || 0;
                    return;
                }
            }
            data.counter.test = data.counter.achiev = 0;
        }

        function saveMultiData() {
            document.cookie = data.cookieKey + '=' + data.counter.test + '|' + data.counter.achiev + '; path=/;';
        }

        if (data.useMultiMode) {
            loadMultiData();
        }

        function eventTrigger() {
            eventFlag = 1;
        }

        function sendToMindbox(customData) {
            if (!data.sendToMindbox) {
                return;
            }

            if (typeof mindbox !== 'function') {
                console.warn('Функция mindbox не найдена. Убедитесь, что скрипт Mindbox подключен.');
                return;
            }

            try {
                var mindboxData = customData || {
                    depth: trackingDepth.depth,
                    timeSpent: data.counter.achiev,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                };

                mindbox("async", {
                    operation: data.mindboxOperation,
                    data: mindboxData,
                    onSuccess: function() {
                        console.log('Событие успешно отправлено в Mindbox');
                        if (data.useMultiMode) {
                            document.cookie = data.sentFlag + '=true; path=/;';
                        } else {
                            if (typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined') {
                                sessionStorage.setItem(data.sentFlag, 'true');
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    onError: function(error) {
                        console.error('Ошибка при отправке в Mindbox:', error);
                    }
                });
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Исключение при вызове mindbox:', e);
            }
        }

        function process() {
            data.counter.test += 1;

            if (data.counter.test === data.testPeriod) {
                if (eventFlag) {
                    eventFlag = 0;
                    data.counter.achiev += data.testPeriod;
                }
                data.counter.test = 0;
            }

            timerHand = setTimeout(process, data.watchEvery);

            var timeCondition = data.counter.achiev >= data.achieveTime;
            var depthCondition = trackingDepth.depth >= data.targetDepth;

            if (timeCondition && depthCondition) {
                if (!data.loop) {
                    clearTimeout(timerHand);
                }
                
                var callbackData = {
                    depth: trackingDepth.depth,
                    timeSpent: data.counter.achiev,
                    achieveTime: data.achieveTime,
                    targetDepth: data.targetDepth,
                    counter: data.counter,
                    visitedPages: trackingDepth.visitedPages
                };
                
                data.callBack.call(global, callbackData);
                sendToMindbox();

                if (data.loop) {
                    data.counter.achiev = 0;
                } else {
                    data.counter.achiev = -1;
                }

                if (!data.loop) {
                    if (data.useMultiMode) {
                        document.cookie = data.sentFlag + '=true; path=/;';
                    } else {
                        if (typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined') {
                            sessionStorage.setItem(data.sentFlag, 'true');
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (data.useMultiMode) {
                saveMultiData();
            }
        }

        var targetElement = querySelector(options && options.target ? options.target : 'body');
        
        if (targetElement && data.counter.achiev !== -1) {
            bindEvent(targetElement, data.eventList, eventTrigger);
        }

        if (data.counter.achiev !== -1) {
            process();
        }

        if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
            window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function() {
                if (data.useMultiMode) {
                    saveMultiData();
                    var depthDataStr = JSON.stringify(trackingDepth);
                    document.cookie = data.depthCookieKey + '=' + encodeURIComponent(depthDataStr) + '; path=/;';
                } else {
                    if (typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined') {
                        sessionStorage.setItem(data.depthCookieKey, JSON.stringify(trackingDepth));
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        console.log('MB Activity Tracking инициализирован. Глубина: ' + trackingDepth.depth + ', Время активности: ' + data.counter.achiev + ' сек.');

        return {
            getDepth: function() { return trackingDepth.depth; },
            getTimeSpent: function() { return data.counter.achiev; },
            getData: function() {
                return {
                    depth: trackingDepth.depth,
                    timeSpent: data.counter.achiev,
                    visitedPages: trackingDepth.visitedPages,
                    counter: data.counter
                };
            },
            reset: function() {
                clearTimeout(timerHand);
                data.counter.test = 0;
                data.counter.achiev = 0;
                if (data.useMultiMode) {
                    document.cookie = data.cookieKey + '=0|0; path=/;';
                }
            }
        };
    }

    if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
        module.exports = mindboxActivityTracking;
    } else {
        global.mindboxActivityTracking = mindboxActivityTracking;
        
        if (hasJQuery) {
            $.fn.mindboxActivityTracking = function(options) {
                return this.each(function() {
                    var pluginOptions = options || {};
                    pluginOptions.target = this;
                    mindboxActivityTracking(pluginOptions);
                });
            };
        }
    }

})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : this);

// Инициализация отслеживания

    callBack: function(data) {
        console.log('Условия выполнены! Глубина: ' + data.depth + ', Время: ' + data.timeSpent + ' сек.');
    }
});
